Messages.Author: Sydnelson
Messages.Body:
A minion with 0 blood and inferior fortitude hunts and play daring the dawn. Its possible play (and pay) freak drive before daring effect?

If yes I gain the blood from hunt and burn after success of hunting action by effect of inferior daring the dawn right?

Messages.Author: Hakuron
Messages.Body:
> Freak Drive
>
> [Action Modifier] [Fortitude] [1 Blood]
>
> [for] Only usable at the end of a successful action (after resolving the action). This vampire untaps.
> [FOR] As above, but usable even if the action is blocked (play after combat, if any).
>
> Daring the Dawn
>
> [Action Modifier] [Fortitude]
>
> [for] Vampires cannot block this action. The acting vampire takes 2 unpreventable aggravated damage after the action resolves.
> [FOR] As above, but the acting vampire takes 1 unpreventable aggravated damage.
>
The two effects share the same window, so you are free to choose their order (like playing first Freak Drive and then Voter Captivation).

Therefore your vampire can hunt, play inf Daring the Dawn, gain one blood, play inf. Freak Drive, pay one blood and untap, take two points of agg. damage, thus goes to torpor and burns.
